title: Survives a break
description: Five upswings from 61,761 to 65,327. On 3 Mar 07:00 the pullback closes at 61,633, below the previous pullback low (61,788): a bearish market structure break. No downswing breaks structure, so the uptrend, confirmed at 62,206 on 3 Mar 12:00, carries on and counts one break against it.
